Pranav Agarwal
pranav.agarwal348@example.com | +91 9693848076 | Koramangala, Bengaluru, India

Professional Summary
Azure-focused DevOps engineer with hands-on experience designing and operating cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and containerized platforms. Strong background automating deployments, managing Azure resources, and improving release velocity through infrastructure-as-code and tooling.

Technical Skills
Microsoft Azure, Terraform, k8s, Azure DevOps, PowerShell, Linux, Git, Jira

Work Experience

Senior Azure DevOps Engineer, Ledgerly (Nov 2025 - Present)
- Designed and implemented Terraform modules to provision Azure Virtual Networks, AKS clusters, and managed identities, reducing environment provisioning time by 60%.
- Automated deployment pipelines in Azure DevOps using YAML templates and PowerShell scripts to orchestrate blue/green releases for microservices, cutting mean time to deploy by 45%.
- Implemented Git branching and PR policies integrated with Azure DevOps and Jira to enforce code quality and traceability across 12 service repositories.

Cloud Engineer, Kite Learning (May 2024 - Oct 2025)
- Led migration of monolithic application to k8s on Azure, creating Helm charts and Azure resource templates to standardize deployments across dev, staging, and prod.
- Built CI/CD workflows using Azure DevOps and Git to automate container builds and multi-environment promotions, improving deployment frequency and rollback reliability.
- Hardened Linux-based container images and implemented Git-based IaC reviews to reduce security findings during scans.

Azure DevOps Engineer, Zoho (Apr 2019 - Apr 2024)
- Managed Microsoft Azure subscriptions and resources for multiple product teams, automating routine tasks with PowerShell and Terraform to maintain consistent environments.
- Operated Kubernetes clusters (k8s) and developed runbooks for cluster upgrades, autoscaling, and incident response on Linux nodes, improving cluster stability.
- Created and maintained Azure DevOps pipelines and Git workflows integrated with Jira for release tracking, enabling predictable monthly releases across services.

Education
B.E., Information Technology, Pune University
